sections.title: Conversation
sections.about: Everything for asking, answering and replying, by text or by voice.

cards.title: Live answer
cards.desc: Answers that stream in with numbered sources and next steps.

cards.title: Composer
cards.desc: Message input with attachments, what to work on, a mode and dictation.

cards.title: Thread panel
cards.desc: Switch between agent threads and reply in place.

cards.title: Artifact card
cards.desc: A file the agent made, with its versions, Open, Copy and Download.

cards.title: Image generation
cards.desc: A prompt with styles, shape and count, pictures that resolve out of grain, and a gallery of earlier ones.

cards.title: Rich text editor
cards.desc: A minimal editor with an inline AI menu that streams a suggestion to accept or discard.

cards.title: Tool call
cards.desc: Each tool the agent calls, with its input and output.

cards.title: Voice capture
cards.desc: Talk to the agent, then fix what it misheard before sending.

cards.title: Voice orb
cards.desc: A hands-free voice chat, with an orb that shows who is talking.

cards.title: Answer action bar
cards.desc: Copy, regenerate, rate and listen to an answer from one row under it.

cards.title: Response versions
cards.desc: Regenerate an answer and flip between versions.

cards.title: Model picker
cards.desc: Pick a model by speed, quality and cost, and how hard it thinks.

cards.title: Prompt starters
cards.desc: Suggested tasks that fill the composer in one click.

cards.title: Prompt library
cards.desc: Saved prompts with blanks to fill in before they go to the agent.

cards.title: Attachment tray
cards.desc: Drop files for the agent and watch each one upload.

cards.title: Feedback sheet
cards.desc: Rate an answer and tell the agent what missed.

sections.title: Agent status
sections.about: Show what the agent is doing, how far along it is, and what it is working with.

cards.title: Thinking
cards.desc: The live trace, written as the agent works, then folded away.

cards.title: Reasoning trail
cards.desc: The agent's plan, notes, sources and edits, after it thinks.

cards.title: Agent lanes
cards.desc: Several agents working in parallel, each with its own lane and hand-offs.

cards.title: Agent tree
cards.desc: An orchestrator and its sub-agents, with cost rolled up per branch.

cards.title: Agent inbox
cards.desc: Every run that needs you, is running or is done, in one list.

cards.title: Trace view
cards.desc: One agent run as a waterfall of spans, with latency and tokens.

cards.title: Browser session
cards.desc: The agent browsing for you, step by step, with Pause and Take over.

cards.title: Web search
cards.desc: The agent's searches as a trail: what it asked, what came back, what it read or skipped, and the answer with its sources.

cards.title: Agent phases
cards.desc: One line for which phase the agent is in, from thinking to done, that stops to ask you, says when it is slow, and folds to how long it took.

cards.title: Run summary
cards.desc: What the agent did, what changed and what needs you.

cards.title: Agent run timeline
cards.desc: Every model and tool step of a run on one time axis.

cards.title: Action log
cards.desc: Every read, search, edit and command, logged as it runs.

cards.title: Context meter
cards.desc: How full the context is and what fills it, with Compact to free room.

cards.title: Error and recovery
cards.desc: A failed step with retry, skip or hand over to a person.

cards.title: Run queue
cards.desc: Agent jobs running, up next and done, with progress, retries and a compact view.

cards.title: Run cost
cards.desc: Live credit and token spend, with a cap that pauses the run.

cards.title: Toast stack
cards.desc: Agent notifications that stack and fan out on hover.

cards.title: Toast
cards.desc: One notification that changes shape with its state.

cards.title: Status pill
cards.desc: One live line for what the agent is doing right now.

cards.title: Step loader
cards.desc: Named steps with a progress track and four loaders.

cards.title: Thinking states
cards.desc: Six thinking indicators to pick from, each with a status line.

sections.title: Review and approve
sections.about: Moments where a person checks, steers or signs off on the agent's work.

cards.title: Change review
cards.desc: Accept or reject each change the agent made, file by file.

cards.title: Plan review
cards.desc: Check the agent's plan, edit steps, then let it run.

cards.title: Permission gate
cards.desc: The agent asks before it touches something new.

cards.title: Hand-off to a person
cards.desc: The agent hands a conversation to a person, with what they need to pick it up.

cards.title: Decision prompt
cards.desc: The agent asks a few quick questions before it starts.

cards.title: Proposal card
cards.desc: A suggested change with confidence, alternatives and undo.

cards.title: Design tuner
cards.desc: Tweak a component by hand or let the agent tune it.

cards.title: Rewrite toolbar
cards.desc: Select a sentence and let the agent rewrite it in place.

cards.title: Launch checklist
cards.desc: The agent checks a design before it ships, and fixes what fails.

cards.title: Inline text diff
cards.desc: The agent's edits to a piece of copy, accepted or rejected one by one.

cards.title: Draft review
cards.desc: An email the agent drafted, to check and edit before it sends.

cards.title: Steering
cards.desc: Change the agent's course while it works, without starting over.

cards.title: Eval results
cards.desc: An eval run case by case, against the run before.

cards.title: Design review
cards.desc: Checks run, a teammate asks for a change, the agent makes it, and you ship.

sections.title: Sources and output
sections.about: What the agent read, what it produced and where each answer came from.

cards.title: Code viewer
cards.desc: Code the agent wrote, with line notes you can ask about.

cards.title: Terminal stream
cards.desc: Shell commands the agent runs, with their output as it streams in.

cards.title: Citation hover card
cards.desc: Hover a citation to see the exact passage it came from.

cards.title: Source stack
cards.desc: Everything the agent read, folded into one quiet pill.

cards.title: Field extraction
cards.desc: The agent pulls fields out of a document and shows where each came from.

cards.title: Metric insight
cards.desc: A number, its trend, and the agent's read on why it moved.

cards.title: Details panel
cards.desc: Properties of a run you can change in place.

cards.title: Task table
cards.desc: Agent tasks in a sortable table with bulk actions.

sections.title: Workspace
sections.about: Navigation, search, settings, models and automations around the agent.

cards.title: Automation canvas
cards.desc: A trigger, a few agent steps, and a run you can watch flow through.

cards.title: Canvas toolbar
cards.desc: A floating toolbar for a workflow canvas: run, pick a tool, comment, fit and zoom.

cards.title: Step inspector
cards.desc: The settings of one step in an agent workflow, in sections that fold.

cards.title: Data picker
cards.desc: Map a field from earlier steps into a step's input.

cards.title: Run drawer
cards.desc: A workflow's run under its canvas: the steps, the log and the data.

cards.title: Command palette
cards.desc: Jump anywhere or hand a task to the agent from one box.

cards.title: Memory panel
cards.desc: What the agent remembers about your team, editable and removable.

cards.title: Model compare
cards.desc: Run one prompt on three models side by side and keep the best.

cards.title: Agent builder
cards.desc: Describe an agent in a sentence and it drafts the rest: who it is, what it may do, what it knows, when it runs. Test it, save it, publish it.

cards.title: Agent settings
cards.desc: How much the agent may do alone, with a save bar for changes.

cards.title: Tools and connections
cards.desc: The tools the agent can reach, and how much it may do with each.

cards.title: Knowledge sources
cards.desc: The files, sites and folders the agent knows, and how far each is indexed.

cards.title: Scheduled runs
cards.desc: Tasks the agent runs on a schedule, with their last result and a switch.

cards.title: File explorer
cards.desc: Project files, with the ones the agent touched marked.

cards.title: Workspace rail
cards.desc: A slim app rail that opens into a labelled sidebar.

sections.title: Harness
sections.about: A live agent conversation built only from the components above. Pick a starter and watch them work together.

cards.title: Agent harness
cards.desc: Every component working together in one agent app.

sections.title: Charts and tables
sections.about: Lightweight charts and tables for dashboards and reports, drawn in plain SVG and HTML.

cards.title: Line chart
cards.desc: Two series over time with a hover readout and toggles.

cards.title: Bar chart
cards.desc: Weekly agent runs, split by outcome, with a range switch.

cards.title: Donut chart
cards.desc: Where the agent's time went, by kind of task.

cards.title: Radial goals
cards.desc: Each agent's share of its own target as a ring, with the overall score in the middle.

cards.title: Funnel chart
cards.desc: Signup to paid, with the biggest drop called out by the agent.

cards.title: Top pages
cards.desc: Most visited pages with share of traffic and a quick sort.

cards.title: Health score
cards.desc: An account's health: a score ring, four factors that open, and the agent's next move.

cards.title: Score breakdown
cards.desc: A score out of 100 whose gauge is split by what goes into it, with the weakest part flagged and a fix to try.

cards.title: Eval radar
cards.desc: This run against the baseline on six eval scores, with the weak ones flagged.

cards.title: Cost vs quality
cards.desc: Every run as a dot by cost and eval score, sized by tokens, with quadrants and a drag to select.

cards.title: Activity heatmap
cards.desc: When the agent and the team were busy, by day and hour.

cards.title: Stat cards
cards.desc: Four headline numbers with sparklines and a period switch.

cards.title: Account table
cards.desc: Customer accounts with health, plan and an agent note per row.

sections.title: Dates
sections.about: Pickers for single dates and date ranges.

cards.title: Date picker
cards.desc: A field that opens a calendar, with quick picks and natural language.

cards.title: Segmented control
cards.desc: Switch between views of the same thing, with a sliding indicator.

cards.title: Date range picker
cards.desc: Pick a start and end across two months, or use a preset.

cards.title: Event calendar
cards.desc: A week view where the agent finds a free slot for you.

cards.title: Agenda
cards.desc: Today's schedule with a live now line and agent prep notes.

sections.title: Forms and inputs
sections.about: Buttons, fields, pickers and sign-in flows for any product.

cards.title: Buttons
cards.desc: Every button style, with loading, success and hold-to-confirm states.

cards.title: Badge
cards.desc: Labels for plans and status, with a dot, an icon or a remove button.

cards.title: Progress and meter
cards.desc: An agent run's progress and what it costs, with a credits meter that warns as it fills.

cards.title: Slider
cards.desc: Named stops, a stepped scale and a range, with the agent's recommended value marked on the track.

cards.title: Tooltip
cards.desc: Quiet labels on hover, with shortcuts and a richer preview card.

cards.title: Search input
cards.desc: Search with scoped filters, recent queries and an agent answer.

cards.title: Country select
cards.desc: A searchable select with country codes, currency and keyboard support.

cards.title: Multi-select
cards.desc: A combobox that filters as you type and keeps your picks as chips.

cards.title: Colour picker
cards.desc: Pick a colour by eye or by hex, check its contrast, and let the agent fix it or make a scale from it.

cards.title: Social sign-in
cards.desc: One-tap providers that remember the last one you used.

cards.title: Sign in
cards.desc: Email first, then the one-time code from the email, copied or typed in.

cards.title: OTP field
cards.desc: A one-time code, one box per digit, that fills from a paste.

cards.title: Form
cards.desc: A project brief with inline checks and an agent that drafts the rest.

cards.title: Payment form
cards.desc: Card details with live formatting, brand detection and a clear total.

cards.title: Carousel
cards.desc: Drafts the agent made to keep one of, or a gallery of pictures, on one swipeable track.

sections.title: Collaboration
sections.about: Threads, inboxes and boards for teams working alongside an agent.

cards.title: Banner
cards.desc: An announcement on a tint of its tone, with its own line drawing.

cards.title: Comments
cards.desc: A design thread where you can @mention the agent and it replies.

cards.title: Notifications
cards.desc: An inbox where agent updates and mentions arrive live.

cards.title: Invite to collaborate
cards.desc: Add teammates by email as chips, set their role, send.

cards.title: Reactions
cards.desc: Quick reactions on an agent update, with counts that pop.

cards.title: Profile menu
cards.desc: The account menu behind an avatar: switch workspace, theme, shortcuts and sign out.

cards.title: Context menu
cards.desc: Right-click an agent reply for its actions, with a submenu that asks the agent about it.

cards.title: Context switcher
cards.desc: The organisation, project and environment you are in, each part a searchable switcher.

cards.title: Filter menu
cards.desc: Add filters from a menu, see them as chips, and watch the count change.

cards.title: Number field
cards.desc: Type a number or step it with minus and plus, with units, limits and a word when a value is changed to fit.

cards.title: Ticket list
cards.desc: Support tickets the agent has triaged, with suggested replies.

cards.title: Kanban board
cards.desc: A sprint board where you and the agent move cards, with filters, details and keyboard moves.

sections.title: Product
sections.about: Pricing, onboarding, setup flows and spending limits for the rest of your product.

cards.title: Pricing cards
cards.desc: Three plans with a billing switch and a seat slider.

cards.title: Onboarding checklist
cards.desc: First steps with a progress ring, and the agent can do some for you.

cards.title: Stepper
cards.desc: A multi-step setup with a progress track that fills as you go.

cards.title: Set limit
cards.desc: A monthly agent budget with a draggable cap and a forecast.

cards.title: Currency converter
cards.desc: Show plan prices in local currency, with a swap and live rate.
